investment_strategy: Position for AI-led secular growth while managing elevated macro volatility (VIX ~23) and higher yields (~4.3% 10Y). Overweight quality, cash-generative AI platforms with durable moats (Microsoft, Alphabet) and add a measured, high-beta exposure to the AI infrastructure cycle (NVIDIA). Size risk defensively: largest weight to the lowest-volatility leader (MSFT), moderate exposure to GOOGL given regulatory overhang, and capped allocation to NVDA due to policy/geopolitical and supply/power constraints. Rebalance quarterly or if a position drifts >5% from target; add on broad market pullbacks of 7–10%. Monitor catalysts: enterprise AI adoption, data center capex, export controls, and antitrust outcomes. Maintain a long-term horizon with tactical trims into sharp rallies and adds on corrections.

portfolio_summary.strategy_focus: Overweight high-quality AI platforms with a measured AI hardware kicker; risk-managed sizing under elevated volatility and higher rates.

analysis_summary.selection_criteria: Preferred lower volatility, strong fundamental growth/ROE, positive analyst consensus, and supportive momentum/trend; incorporated news on AI platform race, regulatory risks, semiconductor geopolitics, and data center energy constraints.
analysis_summary.market_outlook: Cautiously bullish on technology: AI adoption and CHIPS/industrial policy are tailwinds, but expect choppiness with VIX ~23, 10Y ~4.3%, regulatory actions (esp. for Alphabet), and U.S.–China tensions affecting semis. Favor quality leaders and disciplined position sizing.
